# The Great Repurpose

> You weren't meant to be replaced. It's time to Repurpose. The Great Repurpose names the identity crisis underneath AI workforce disruption and offers a path through it: five stages, ten Repurpose Profiles, and two organizational programs — the Executive Leadership Academy and the TGR Transition Academy.

The Great Repurpose is a movement and a set of programs for people and organizations whose work and identity are being reshaped by AI. The premise: it's not us versus AI, it's us amplified by AI. Individuals take a free 7-question Repurpose Profile assessment. Organizations engage TGR Academy: leadership training for executives making AI-era workforce decisions, and transition support for employees whose roles have ended.

Founded by Kyle Shannon with Andee Harris. Site: https://thegreatrepurpose.com/

## The five stages of The Great Repurpose

1. Unhook Identity — "I'm not my job." Separate your worth from the title, craft, task list, or workflow AI may be disrupting. You are more than the work you used to perform.
2. Reclaim Value — "Here's who I am." Name the durable human layer underneath the tasks: taste, judgment, perspective, trust, relationships, and lived experience.
3. Discover Purpose — "What matters to me." Point your reclaimed value toward a problem, audience, community, or contribution that gives your next chapter direction.
4. Become AI Ready — "Understand AI's power to amplify your ideas." Put yourself at the center and explore AI without expectations. Play is how you find out what you can actually do with it.
5. Relaunch Yourself — "Turn who you are into work, opportunity, and income." Turn who you are into visible work, real opportunities, and income that no longer depends on one employer.

## For individuals

- [Repurpose Profile assessment](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/selfcheck): Free 7-question, 2-minute self check scoring you across the five stages. Results include your profile definition, an automation-risk read, a radar across Identity, Purpose, Relaunch, AI Ready, and Value, stage-by-stage scores, AI-generated insights, tactical recommendations, and a downloadable PDF report.
- [The 10 Repurpose Profiles](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/types): Grouped by where you are on the journey.
  - Identity Seekers — the work right now is inner: who are you when the title falls away? The Unlocker, The Awakener, The Explorer.
  - Direction Finders — you know yourself; now the work is aiming it at something that matters. The Firestarter, The Translator, The Original.
  - Builders in Motion — the foundation is set; the work is shipping, not preparing. The Compass, The Architect, The Catalyst.
  - The Amplifier — you've made it through. Now the real work begins.
- [The Five Stages](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/phases): Detailed breakdown of each stage and what the work looks like there.

## For organizations (TGR Academy)

- [TGR Academy](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/academy): Lighting the path forward into the future of work. Overview of both programs, who they are for, and how to engage.
- [Executive Leadership Academy](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/academy/leadership): An executive workshop and implementation program for leading through the AI transition. For CEOs, COOs, CHROs, heads of talent, and workforce transformation leads. An eight-hour immersive workshop plus ninety-minute implementation sessions every two weeks for three months, applied to the real workforce, technology, and organizational decisions already on the table. Premise: 95% of enterprise GenAI pilots show no measurable P&L impact, 55% of leaders who cut staff for AI say those were the wrong calls, and 70% of the skills used in most jobs will change by 2030 — the gap is leadership, not technology.
- [TGR Transition Academy](https://thegreatrepurpose.com/academy/transition): Outplacement reimagined for an AI-shaped future. For HR and people teams supporting departing employees. Traditional outplacement polishes resumes for jobs that are disappearing; the Transition Academy moves a cohort through the five stages together — unhooking identity, reclaiming value, discovering purpose, becoming AI ready, and relaunching. Runs standalone or layered onto an existing outplacement vendor.
